# Copilot instructions — playos-foundation

Organizational home of the PlayOS Foundation: website, governance, roadmap,
community, branding. **No platform code**; platform behavior lives in
[`playos-spec`](https://github.com/PlayOS-Foundation/playos-spec). Also read
`AGENTS.md`.

## Rules for changes here

1. **No platform behavior** — that belongs in `playos-spec`.
2. **Governance & community** are the focus (charter, CoC, roadmap).
3. **Branding integrity** — consistent names, logos, usage guidelines.
4. **Accuracy** — public materials match the current spec/implementations.
